title: Visibility Obstruction - Hazardous
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a hazardous visibility obstruction caused by overgrown vegetation blocking the view of traffic. ** Overgrown trees, bushes, and vegetation on private property is the property owner's responsibility. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about vegetation dangerously blocking the view of traffic.
actions.why: For a hazardous traffic-visibility obstruction caused by overgrown trees, bushes, or other vegetation blocking a driver’s view. This request must be dispatched, and the saved instructions direct people to call 311.
actions.why_not: This City call-in service does not cover vegetation confined to private property; the description assigns private-property trees and vegetation to the owner.
